about: Patterns that recheck does not call safe, with the reason each cannot take super-linear time in the library. scripts/check-redos.mjs fails on any other such pattern, and on an entry here that no longer matches a shipped pattern or that recheck now calls safe. source is the exact RegExp source and flags its flags.

allow.where: library/syllable.js BREAK_RULES.zawgyi, last rule (applied by markBreaks at library/syllable.js:282)
allow.reason: On its own the rule takes quadratic time on a long run of e or medial ra glyphs with no consonant after them (recheck attack: U+1031 repeated, then U+1031 U+200B U+1031 U+1025). markBreaks never gives it such a run: syllBreak and truncate remove U+200B and U+200C from the text first (contentGate.cleanText), and the second Zawgyi rule puts U+200B before every e and medial ra glyph (an e keeps one medial ra), so no run is longer than two glyphs. Of the rules in between, only the kinzi rule removes a U+200B between two such glyphs, one before each consonant with kinzi, so this rule reads runs of at most four glyphs; the others remove a U+200B before a consonant or after a space or opening punctuation. Measured on 20,000 e: the rule alone 283 ms, syllBreak and truncate 1-2 ms, linear; test/growth.timing.js times both call forms.
